paragraphs: I am excited to apply for the Online - Client Services Coordinator position at Destination Careers. My background in event coordination and customer service aligns well with your requirements, and I am confident my skills will contribute positively to your team's success.

Throughout my career, I have demonstrated strong organizational abilities and a proactive approach to managing diverse client needs. As an intern at International House Oulu, I coordinated 14 community events, averaging 25 international participants each, showcasing my logistics management and communication skills. My legal experience at Poise Legal involved drafting and negotiating commercial agreements for corporate clients, further highlighting my ability to handle multiple tasks efficiently.

I am currently pursuing Finnish supplementary law studies at the University of Lapland (OPH-recognised), which reflects my commitment to integrating international expertise with local practices. I am fluent in both English and Finnish, allowing me to communicate effectively within your team and serve your clients.

Destination Careers' focus on customer care and planning assistance resonates strongly with my own values and experience. I am eager to bring my skills and enthusiasm to your Client Services team, contributing to the company's mission of providing exceptional client experiences.
Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Destination Careers' success.
